description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Syrix, adding {1}.
Choose not to move Syrix from your graveyard to the command zone.
Syrix dies, triggering Pitiless Plunderer, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Skyfire Phoenix, adding {1}.
Skyfire Phoenix dies, triggering Syrix and Pitiless Plunderer.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate both Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{R}.
Resolve the Syrix trigger, causing you to pay {2}{B}{R} to cast Syrix from your graveyard.
Skyfire Phoenix triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
